scope: Read-only independent source, test, measurement, documentation and retained-evidence audit. No compiler builds, guest executions, performance measurements or chart rendering were run by this reviewer.
resolved_findings: The archive initially captured its mutable package.log before the final log write. The packager now excludes that log; the final archive roundtrip has no mismatches.

Installed stdlib sources, Wasmtime SDK headers and the host build manifest were initially absent. They and remaining current pinned text inputs are now retained; all 1,552 scanned source/metadata pin references resolve to retained content.

checks.compiler: Only the UnrollWhile eligibility helper and four-way byte cloning are present. The owned iteration substring excludes the final backedge. Each copy has identical outer branch depths, local IDs, condition evaluation, traps, stores and cleanup order. Eligibility excludes source calls, declarations, nonlocal slots, owners and control transfers; explicit emitter-state checks require balanced labels, exits, cleanups, private headers, temporary scopes and live regions. No rejected branch-form or load-CSE change remains.
checks.tests: Reviewed the 12 added differential cases at O0/O2 with debug on/off, including narrow integer widths, slices, aliases, impure fallbacks and bounds/division traps. The focused test checks 0–5 iteration tails and traps after 0–4 committed stores on both engines: 88 checks. CI includes the test.
checks.qualification: The retained differential report contains 9,573 passing observations and records 7,656 native stdout comparisons. All 46 focused commands exited successfully. The host replay contains 11,484 unique passing rows with all recorded comparisons true and matching before/after input and AOT pins. Removing the stale fixed unit count preserves live case inventory, exact baseline coverage, deduplication and exact replay coverage checks.
checks.compiler_and_guest_identity: Current compiler SHA matches the measured 82b14bd7e795864606042853b13994e0fa8e6bddb22f02f9eef19d87849043e8. The retained compiler patch equals the current compiler diff. All five compiler variants reconstruct from archived headers and identical shared headers. All 663 public guest paths resolve through the artifact map to 99 correctly hashed retained byte sequences. Sorting changes only one defined function body, 444 to 825 bytes; module size changes 96,308 to 96,689 bytes. The candidate SHA matches the immutable four-way experiment.
checks.statistics: Recomputed 1,207 retained summary statistics. Reconstructed every baseline/candidate paired sample and ratio in final, branch, guard, load, nearby and repeated-nearby reports. All agree with the stored summaries.
checks.raw_evidence: Checked 3,858 archived golden outputs and associated timing records across the four paired cohorts, nearby cohorts, fresh example cohort and native-host cohort. Checked all 210 LangArena execution checksum/timing rows and all 200 native preparation artifact hashes. All sampled archive members match the corresponding current bytes; the full archive roundtrip had no mismatches.
checks.charts_and_claims: All 373 numeric SVG labels match retained cells in exact series order across nine charts. All three latest pointers and four README source-report hashes match. README summary rows equal the fresh LangArena cohort. Verified published build ranges, process medians, preparation sums and break-even estimates. The native-process preview is legible. No V8 gain or unchanged-module kernel gain is attributed to unrolling; rejected regressions and separate engine-flag controls remain visible.

limitations: This is a static and retained-data review, not an independent rerun of the recorded qualification or performance experiments.

Shared-host noise is material. Paired medians and MAD are descriptive and do not establish formal equivalence, confidence bounds or a general speedup. The unchanged controls and nearby variants constrain the claim to these workloads and engines.

Instrumented entry intervals include initialization, callbacks and possible lazy JIT; they are not pure kernels. Ordinary process cohorts, paired entry probes, sampled profiles and engine-flag controls have distinct timing boundaries. Precompiled process times exclude the separately measured preparation cost.
V8 evidence supports a tiering explanation for rejected regressions but does not timestamp the exact optimized-code transition within each measured call or establish a universal engine cost.

Default precompiled mode did not receive the full host replay; its separately recorded example and public WAT coverage is disclosed. Full replay guest binaries and external compiler/engine binaries remain omitted with identities retained as documented.
Only the native-process preview was visually inspected by this reviewer. The retained chart verification records the parent reviewer’s visual inspection of all nine charts.
The final SHA256 manifest and this review are intentionally excluded from the reviewed-file fingerprints to avoid circular claims.
